primer.depth.1: Films only is the cinema run on its own, which is the spine of the story.
primer.depth.2: Plus series adds the television that carries the main story forward. Since 2021 it is not optional.
primer.depth.3: Plus everything adds the shorts, the specials, the older television, and the films made by other studios.
primer.depth.a: The second control chooses how much is included. Each step adds to the one before it.
primer.depth.q: How much of it do I want?
primer.depth.tip: To follow the whole story without getting lost, plus series is enough.
primer.order.a: The first control changes the whole list.
primer.order.chrono: Story order is when events happen. Captain Marvel is set in 1995, so it moves in front of Iron Man.
primer.order.q: In what order should I watch?
primer.order.release: Release order is how things actually came out, from 2008 onward. It never spoils anything you have not reached.
primer.order.tip: First time? Start with release order.
primer.separate.1: The connected run happens on one Earth. Twenty years of X-Men films and the Sony films happen on others, made by other studios under other licences.
primer.separate.2: A few entries of the connected run are set elsewhere too, and say so on their own row.
primer.separate.a: Not everything here belongs to the same story.
primer.separate.tip: Turn the third control on only when you want those as well.
